The position at the bottom center shows a tomato plant, with red tomato fruits growing on it; this stage is labeled with the letter E. Reasoning: The question asks which letter corresponds to the stage in which the flower produces fruit. Producing fruit should correspond to the stage in the image where red tomatoes have already grown, therefore it corresponds to the letter E.
